evidence.title: 圆明园遗址的遗产价值与申遗构想: the buildings left after 1860, citing 刘敦桢 1933
evidence.locator: ylfj, note 34: 刘敦桢, 同治重修圆明园史料, 营造学社汇刊 1933(2)
evidence.summary: Lists 17 buildings left after the burning of 1860, after 刘敦桢: 紫碧山房, 顺木天, 鱼跃鸢飞, 课农轩, 藏舟坞, 慎修思永, 知过堂, 双鹤斋, 蓬岛瑶台, 魁星楼, 文昌阁, 林渊锦镜, 春雨轩; 海岳开襟; 庄严法界, 正觉寺 and a 大宫门 in 万春园. The paper's aim is to hold any new display to this 1860 state.

evidence.title: 天然图画 文昌阁 (S47 section 2.16)
evidence.summary: By 静知春事佳 and the 苏堤春晓 pavilion, plaque 三宗会极, after Daoguang in S47's view. Xianfeng burned incense here on the 21st of the third lunar month of 1860. Damaged in 1860, rebuilt 1871 and standing in the survey of 1873: so its 1860 form is not known.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum, Historical Photographs of China, the Rijksmuseum, Wellcome and in NDL's albums of about 1900; today's photographs on Commons.
